descriptionHtml:
Approach · TC-24 Deletions · S02 Nursing Home: the same three deletes before processing stay out of the summary and the note

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U1 A medication row, a task or an Important Point deleted before processing is not included in the summary (the pre-round Save Note result) or in the generated note. (UAT TC-24) — gate: blocked: TFA-94699 in progress
  • U10 Every TC-24 rule holds in both Hospital and Nursing Home, including deleting a Nursing Home resident. (UAT 3.3; UAT TC-24)

Test design technique: Happy path (happy-path) — Walk the normal flow exactly as the UAT / ticket words it; everything it names has to show up.

Given Fresh physician. The Nursing Home resident is seeded with three medication rows, three open tasks and two Important Points.

When Delete the furosemide row, the point 'Monitor sacral pressure area' and the task 'Podiatry referral', confirming each. Type the pre-round text and press Save Note. Type the visit text, press Save & Extract, then Generate Note & Finish.

Then The summary and the note do not mention furosemide, podiatry or the sacral pressure area. The note carries today's visit text. The rows and items that were not deleted are still on the chart.

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): U1 in Nursing Home (3.3). oracle.mjs: the summary and note checkpoints must not contain 'furosemide', 'podiatry' or 'sacral'. Positive controls (oracleRules 1): 'Donepezil' on the summary, 'Weekly weight Monday' on the task list and 'walker' on the note (today's visit text, which Post-Round does not show; a missing control makes the run Invalid). …

Where it ran: dev; test method AGENT · Browser agent; lane planned in the matrix: browser agent (automated)

S02 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/TC-24.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Environment: dev — dev deployment, build 25acd72 (Deploy Convex, 2026-10-15T14:04:39Z); account and address are not written into the report; run folder runs/2026-10-14-dev.

Test method: AGENT · Browser agent; secondary: AICHECK · AI output check — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on dev; Source: dev.
